title: A probe that timed out measured the clock, not the model

subject.signature: probe(ctx: Ctx, model: string, kind: Kind = "schema", cache = openCache()): Promise<Entry | undefined>

invariant: probe writes a durable catalog entry via cache.record only when the call succeeded (r.ok) or when measuresCapability(state) is true. A timeout takes the separate cache.recordSlow path and is never recorded as a schema result. Anything else that failed is not written down at all.
why: The 60s probe ceiling was being written to disk as `{ ok: false, ms: 60283 }` — once stored, indistinguishable from a model that answered and got the schema wrong. Two different facts collapsing into one row is how a working model gets retired for being slow once. The probe runs under its own bounded context (timeoutMs 60_000, maxAttempts 1, retryTimeout false) precisely so the ceiling is a known quantity rather than an inherited one; recording the ceiling as a capability would make that bound self-defeating.

cases.name: a successful probe is recorded
cases.must_not: discarding a good measurement and re-probing on every run

cases.name: a malformed answer is recorded as a capability fact
cases.must_not: re-probing a model forever when the call itself already settled the question

cases.name: a timeout is recorded as slow, never as a schema verdict
cases.must_not: cache.record({ ok: false, ms: 60283 }) — a row that reads, forever, as 'this model cannot produce schema output' when all that happened is that 60 seconds elapsed

cases.name: a provider failure is not written down at all
cases.must_not: persisting provider weather as a model property

cases.name: a cached answer short-circuits before any model call
cases.must_not: spending a live model call to re-derive something already known — each probe is a full call, and the day half the providers are down is when probing is most tempting and least useful

cases.name: only schema is probed; agentic reads the cache and stays unknown otherwise
cases.must_not: inferring agentic capability from the schema result — musespark and deepseek pass agentic while failing schema, so neither is evidence of the other

regression_signature: The `else if (state === "timeout") cache.recordSlow(model)` branch merged back into the record() call, or the record() guard widened past `r.ok || measuresCapability(state)`. Either one puts the probe's own ceiling into the catalog as a model capability.
